summary: Seed an active GitHub provider when a managed Cloud tenant is created.
userImpact: New managed Cloud organizations can select GitHub when connecting a repository.

instructions: Deploy the shared and host packages from the same qualified release.

configuration: The default GitHub provider uses the configured OAuth client when one is available. Personal access token support remains available.

notes: The provider record and the new organization are written in the same transaction and tenant scope.

security: The provider remains subject to the existing tenant isolation and connection authorization checks.

customerDocumentation.reason: Restores the existing GitHub repository connection flow for new managed organizations.

knownLimitations: Existing organizations retain their configured providers.
rollback: Use the previous qualified host. Any provider records created before rollback remain scoped to their organizations.
validation: Focused tenant-service and restricted PostgreSQL tests cover the new default, existing self-hosted seeding and transaction rollback.
